summary: V2 Coach Dashboard Iteration 4 (P1a + P1b) — frontend-only, all 6 flows PASS. Tested on client@crewfit.com (Alex Rivera, V2 flag, no programme) since testcal2@crewfit.com is not present in Louis's coach client list (only reviewer@crewfit.net + louis@hotmail.co.uk returned). Roster upload button renders inline in ribbon; 6-tab bar renders with correct testIDs (v2-tab-plan default active + checkins/messages/progress/history/goals); switching to each panel loads correctly; Messages round-trip works end-to-end (sent 'Test from V2 workspace', bubble appeared instantly on right side); AI/bot/generated/artificial/algorithm/machine-learning sweep found ZERO hits across all 6 panels; V1 legacy screen still renders untouched. One console 401 during initial anonymous nav (pre-token) is benign. Two minor testID coverage misses on empty states (CheckinsPanel/HistoryPanel empty branches lack outer testID wrapper) — flagged as MINOR.

ui_bugs.issue: When rows.length === 0 the panel renders a <View style={styles.center}> without testID='v2-checkins-panel'. The visible empty-state copy is correct ('No check-ins yet' / 'The client hasn't submitted a wellness check-in...') but the panel testID is only attached to the populated branch. Ref: /app/frontend/src/components/V2ClientTabs.tsx:57-63
Empty state branch renders <View style={styles.center}> without testID='v2-history-panel'. Ref: /app/frontend/src/components/V2ClientTabs.tsx:298-304

issues: Cosmetic: at width 1280 the ribbon back button + 'CrewFit' brand logo are cut off (out of viewport in some captured screenshots) — layout ok but the back button overlaps the top-left. Non-blocking.
The compact 'UPLOAD ROSTER' pill uses backgroundColor #4a90e2 which is off-brand vs the neighbouring theme.color.brand (dark red). Consider aligning to brand tokens.
Ionicons in the tab bar sometimes render squares/glyph fallback on first frame while the icon font loads (transient).

react_native_issues.issue: Console shows 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow' — RN Web deprecation, not blocking but should be migrated. Widely emitted across the app (not new in this iteration).
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning surfaced on the workspace screen (likely from a Modal/Pressable) — not new to this iteration.

action_items: MINOR: Add testID='v2-checkins-panel' to the CheckinsPanel empty-state <View> at V2ClientTabs.tsx:57 so tests can assert the panel exists regardless of data.
MINOR: Add testID='v2-history-panel' to the HistoryPanel empty-state <View> at V2ClientTabs.tsx:298 for the same reason.
Optional consistency: also add testID to the ActivityIndicator wrappers in each panel's loading branch (v2-*-panel) so tests never fall through the DOM.

SEED (informational): testcal2@crewfit.com is not returned by GET /api/coach/clients for louis@crewfit.net (coach list = 2: reviewer@crewfit.net + louis@hotmail.co.uk). Tests were run against client@crewfit.com (Alex Rivera) instead. If Iter 94s seed for testcal2 is meant to be assigned to Louis, re-run the seed or reassign — otherwise richer-data test paths (5 workouts, missed sessions) cannot be exercised by Louis via coach dashboard.
Cosmetic: align the compact 'UPLOAD ROSTER' pill background (#4a90e2) with the brand palette (theme.color.brand) so ribbon buttons match visually.
critical_code_review_comments: workspace.tsx (818 lines) is getting large; consider extracting TabBar, DayRowView, WorkoutDrawer and StatusChip into siblings under /components/workspace/ to keep the file under 700 lines.
V2ClientTabs.tsx renders 5 independent panels each with its own load state duplicating error/loading UI — could be lifted into a small usePanelData hook. Non-blocking.

MessagesPanel fromCoach detection: MessageBubble receives coachId = m.from_user_id when m.from_user_id !== clientId — that means every non-client sender is treated as coach and the very first coach message may not have a stable coachId until the list contains at least one client message. Not a P1 bug but worth revisiting.
seed_data_creation: None. Sent one live message 'Test from V2 workspace' from Louis → Alex Rivera (client@crewfit.com) via POST /api/messages while validating Flow 4.

rca_of_issue: No functional bugs. testID gap on empty states is a straightforward oversight — the panel-level testID lives on the populated branch only; wrap the empty <View> or return early with an outer <View testID=…> encompassing both branches.
